failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 2017年上半年首单用户
first_half_2017_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE 
        order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
        AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
        AND order_id IN (
            SELECT order_id
            FROM (
                SELECT 
                    customer_id, 
                    order_id,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_purchase_timestamp) as rn
                FROM orders
                WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
                    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
            ) t
            WHERE rn = 1
        )
),
-- 2017年下半年这些用户的下单情况
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count
    FROM orders o
    JOIN first_half_2017_customers f ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' 
        AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= '2017-12-31'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
-- 计算每月留存用户数
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as retained_customers
    FROM second_half_2017_orders
    GROUP BY order_month
),
-- 2017年上半年首单用户总数
total_first_half_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as total_customers
    FROM first_half_2017_customers
)
-- 计算留存率
SELECT 
    m.order_month,
    m.retained_customers,
    t.total_customers,
    ROUND(m.retained_customers * 100.0 / t.total_customers, 2) as retention_rate_percent
FROM monthly_retention m
CROSS JOIN total_first_half_customers t
ORDER BY m.order_month
LIMIT 6;
